item.title: Letter: Is income tax meant to cover unaccounted for federal funds?
item.description: The House Finance Committee has advanced Senate Bill 6346, a 9.9 percent tax on incomes over $1 million. This is a calculated violation of Initiative 2111, which the state Legislature passed to ban a personal income tax.

item.title: Letter: Concerns for breaching lower Snake dams overstated

First, most of the people who spoke recognized the importance of salmon for the survival of the Southern Resident orcas, and for Washington’s economy and character.
